header: THE SHELF OF PROVEN QUESTIONS, drawn in the search window while the Executive Deep Search button is chosen by an executive and nothing has been asked yet (the window decides when: src/components/OmnibarModal.tsx). I use it to teach by example: what a deep question looks like, and what each kind asks for. Every question is a link; pressing it puts the question in the box and runs it at once (no Enter). A question the person writes himself still needs Enter. The questions and their groups are in src/lib/help/edsExamples.ts (which reads the guide's own list). The window scrolls this panel when it is taller than the window.

symbols.name: EdsExamples
symbols.sig: export function EdsExamples({ onPick }: { onPick: (question: string) => void })

behaviours: every question of the guide is on the shelf, exactly once, and the shelf adds A-C3 (plain words, verified on screen) H01-H08 (the 'hidden' type) and N01-N06 (six more, all tried on 23 Nov 2026)
the shelf holds the guide's questions word for word (one source)
every question reaches Executive Deep Search as typed (the real detector says synthesis)
the shelf has the FOUR TYPES of the keywords, in the same order and under the same titles (hidden, action words, what changed, stage by stage)
every question is filed under exactly one type; 38 questions in all
every type has questions (the 'hidden' type has eight), none shows a template, and the guide's wording is untouched
each 'hidden' question is built on a word of the 'enough on their own' list and reaches EDS on that word alone (5 points or more from discovery language)
each 'hidden' question says what it found when tried, in the shelf's own note
a question that contains a keyword stands under that keyword's type (hidden words > stage-by-stage words > what-changed words > action words)
every question says what it teaches and which circulars it reads
the honesty test (E23) says so in plain words and reads 'nothing', not the project's test note; no developer note (scored / panel / went to the normal search) reaches a reader
${i.note ?? ""} ${i.needs}
the templates at the foot are the guide's
every question is drawn once as a link (an anchor with an address) with its text
the groups are drawn in order, each with its heading
the panel is a labelled section (a landmark) with a header saying what EDS is and the count, and a 'Write your own' foot
each question names the circulars it reads, and its kind
each word of the 'enough alone' list reaches 5 points by itself
each other keyword makes a deep question once two years are named (3 + 2 points)
...and does NOT reach EDS alone, so the text is right to say it needs one more clue
the keywords are drawn, group by group, each word once

the text above the questions says they are examples; the text above the keywords says a keyword makes the bar recognise it at once, that Enter runs one's own, and that under the button every question is already deep
the keywords come BEFORE the questions (the user asked for the explanation above the list)
brief: the intro lines are one or two short sentences (under 200 characters each)
pressing a question calls onPick with that question's own text, and the page does not jump (preventDefault)
it can be reached and used from the keyboard (an anchor with an address, a visible focus ring)
the window runs a pressed question as Executive Deep Search at once (runEds: the text goes into the box and the search starts; no Enter)
the shelf shows only to an executive who chose the button and has asked nothing (no search made, not loading, no 'Are you an executive?', no notice, no utility page open)
above an answer, 'All sample questions' brings the shelf back and empties the box
a question the person types still needs Enter (the Enter handler is the only other way into runEds)
the bar shows no example buttons under Executive Deep Search any more (the shelf is the examples)
once a deep answer is on screen the row of buttons (RecordsScopeBar) is taken away for room, and it is drawn again with the way back (or when the box text changes: isStale)

a question PRESSED from the samples has 'All sample questions' (back to the shelf and the buttons); a question TYPED (or sent to the deep search by Enter in Everything) has a plain 'Back' to the ordinary window: Everything, empty box
